title: To grieve, or not to grieve?
author: Kevin Buzzard

metaphors.title: Natural boundary
metaphors.paraphrase: Machines will stop at some boundary where the next leap is not worth the resources; humans then journey to where they stopped.

metaphors.title: Revealed truth
metaphors.paraphrase: An unreadable AI Lean proof as a “revealed” truth, unquestionable and undemocratic (comment summarizing Gamburd).

metaphors.title: Die on that hill
metaphors.paraphrase: Scholze will not use AI and will die on that hill (quoted).

metaphors.title: Five stages of grief
metaphors.paraphrase: Denial, anger, bargaining and depression all well represented in the community.

metaphors.title: Sudoku on a changing board
metaphors.paraphrase: Not ever more sudokus: the board changes shape and dimension; the team just got a superstar new player.

metaphors.title: Lean as source of truth
metaphors.paraphrase: Decrypting Lean into English; “theoremmaxxing”; a smart kid who's an expert in the field.

metaphors.title: Infinity beats exponential
metaphors.paraphrase: Mathematics is infinite, which beats exponential growth hands down.
